description.zh:
订购份数。根据物联网卡本身的套餐类型选择订购份数。
- 续订月套餐：支持1、2、3、6、9、12。

- 续订年套餐：支持1、2、3。

- 订购叠加包：支持1、2、3。
description.en:
The number of units to purchase. Select the number based on the plan type of the IoT card. Valid values:
- Renew a monthly plan: 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, or 12.
- Renew an annual plan: 1, 2, or 3.
- Purchase an add-on package: 1, 2, or 3.

description.zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在物联网SIM服务控制台的卡管理页面，查看ICCID。
description.en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can find the ICCID on the IoT card itself, or on the Card Management page of the IoT SIM Service console.

description.zh:
充值类型为订购叠加包时需填写。

具体Code请咨询技术对接人员。
description.en:
This parameter is required when the recharge type is set to add-on package purchase.

Contact your technical support representative for the specific code.

description.zh:
充值类型。

- STANDARD：续订套餐。

- OVERLAY ：订购叠加包。
description.en:
The recharge type. Valid values:

- STANDARD: renews a plan subscription.
- OVERLAY: purchases an add-on package.

description.zh:
自定义的订单编号，编号需唯一且保持幂等性。

如果您的充值，涉及自有平台的订单管理，如给下游客户充值等，您可填入自有平台已生成的外部订单编号，该接口调用成功后，会生成一个订单编号（OrderNo）。该参数可以方便您将生成的订单编号与外部订单号关联起来。如果非此场景，你可填入任意正整数，例如0。
description.en:
The custom order number. The number must be unique and idempotent.

If your recharge involves order management on your own platform, such as recharging for downstream customers, you can enter an external order number generated by your platform. After this operation is called successfully, an order number (OrderNo) is generated. This parameter helps you associate the generated order number with the external order number. If this scenario does not apply, enter any positive integer, such as 0.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits

The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for this operation is 20.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
